outcome: Dispatch events name what was dispatched again: the association body for the dispatch event family carries the responsibility alongside effect, work, and slice - restoring the additivity operator-surface S5 promised and did not keep - and the conformance suite reads it directly instead of joining through sealed submissions to learn what the event stream used to say.

exclude: model output in event bodies (the association stays content-free of provider content)
webhook and cockpit projections (they classify by kind and offset; body enrichment is additive beneath them)

waivers.reason: its tests reach internal/runtime by import only; no cmd test pins dispatch event bodies
its tests reach internal/runtime by import only; the webhook and projector classify by kind and offset, and body enrichment is additive beneath them
its tests reach internal/runtime via internal/cockpit by import only; the continuation aggregate parses kinds, never dispatch bodies
its tests reach internal/runtime by import only; no tui test pins dispatch event bodies

acceptance.text: dispatch_completed and dispatch_operational_failure event bodies carry the dispatched responsibility alongside the association fields (internal/runtime/association.go MarshalAssociation; the pre-S5 body was coordinates.Responsibility outright - git show d36227da~1:internal/runtime/dispatch.go - and the post-S5 body at the dispatch.go eventBody sites dropped it). Pinned by runtime event-body tests across the dispatch family.

The conformance suite derives dispatch order from the event bodies directly again: assertDispatchOrder (test/e2e/walking_skeleton_linux_test.go) reads responsibility from the event, and the interim join through the effect's sealed submission is retired - declared CI evidence per ADR-0010, first executed by the CI run on the merge.

The body stays content-free of model output: responsibility is the engine's own dispatch coordinate, and no provider content, prompt, or submission text enters any event body - pinned by the same tests.

constraints: Approving this slice is the sworn#229 ruling: the association-only dispatch body is ruled a regression against operator-surface S5's stated additivity, and the fix is to restore responsibility additively - not to reinterpret S5's note as superseded. If the operator strikes this slice before approval, sworn#229 remains open for a standalone ruling.

Additive only: consumers of the current association shape keep working; the e2e change removes the workaround, never weakens an assertion (no exactly-once, cardinality, or authority assertion is weakened anywhere in test/e2e).
Check evidence belongs in the submission's checks field, never in files added to the repository.
